items.title: Who is Jensen Huang? Nvidia chief under scrutiny over affair and spying reports
items.summary: Nvidia's board is meeting to decide whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang, as the AI chip giant grapples with reports of two extramarital affairs involving its longtime leader. Huang's future is now in the balance at the company he co-founded and helped transform into a global AI powerhouse. We look back at his rise and his journey to becoming one of the most influential figures in the AI industry.

items.summary: Democratic nominee Scott Colom defeated Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith on Wednesday in Mississippi's closely contested US Senate race after a prolonged ballot counting process, giving the state its first Black US senator since post-Civil War Reconstruction. items.title: Two dead, several injured after New York building collapses
items.summary: Two people were killed Wednesday and at least 17 others injured, including children, after a three-story building collapsed near a construction site in New York, city authorities said. The building fell into a neighboring excavation site, trapping several people who firefighters worked to free over several hours using drones, search dogs and chainsaws.

items.title: Hybrid warfare: Hoax bomb alerts sent to schools in Italy, UK in latest disruption
items.summary: Schools were evacuated across Italy on Wednesday following a series of hoax bomb threats. Similar hoax threats were reported in schools in Britain, Scotland and Ireland. The threats come after a series of hoax bomb alerts in recent weeks including on flights across Europe and cyber attacks on supermarket refrigeration systems in several European countries, including Italy. items.title: Kylian Mbappé to miss Thursday's Nations League clash against Italy
items.summary: It's a major blow for France. Coach Zinédine Zidane will have to do without his captain, Kylian Mbappé, this Thursday as Les Bleus take on Italy in the Nations League. The Real Madrid forward is suffering from minor hamstring discomfort but could return for Sunday's clash against Turkey. In the meantime, Zidane has decided to call up Senny Mayulu for his first senior international appearance.

items.title: UK economy grows 0.7% in third quarter as AI demand lifts output
items.summary: Britain’s economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter, in line with expectations. Computer programming and consultancy helped drive growth as demand for AI and cloud computing rose, while the Iran war pushed up energy costs.

items.title: Smart homes, new threats: Could everyday appliances be hacked?
items.summary: Should we be worried about cyberattacks targeting everyday household appliances, from smart vacuums to washing machines and food processors? The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity has warned that these connected devices could become vulnerable to hacking, prompting experts to call for greater investment in cybersecurity to address emerging threats.
